title: STT serving endpoint, v1
description: Bodies of POST /serving-endpoints/{name}/invocations for speech-to-text: the Databricks custom-model (MLflow pyfunc) envelope. One record per utterance; one prediction per record, in the same order. Audio is base64 (RFC 4648 §4, padded) of raw PCM: signed 16-bit little-endian, mono, 16 kHz, so the byte length is even. See README.md.

request.description: Request body. `dataframe_records` is MLflow's records-oriented DataFrame input.

utterance.description: One utterance to transcribe, at most 30 s.

audio_b64.description: Base64 of PCM s16le mono samples; 1 sample to 30 s (960,000 bytes, 1,280,000 base64 characters).

encoding.description: Sample format of audio_b64. Signed 16-bit little-endian PCM.

sample_rate.description: Samples per second of audio_b64. Phone audio (8 kHz) is resampled by the caller.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the speech, as a hint. Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 is English-only.

text.description: The transcript, trimmed; empty when no speech was recognised.

error.description: Body of every non-200 response: the Databricks REST error shape.
